clusters.title: GPU 1 on MI35x `mia1-p02-g22` runs out of memory with about 84 GiB reported free

details.label: Status
details.text: `[FACT]`: 5 jobs in 2 runs, all on `mia1-p02-g22`. Two were in the Nov 15 16:06 rocm10 nightly and three in the Nov 15 21:08 nightly (rocm720, rocm724). Each job started with 0% VRAM in use, so this is not the full-GPU problem.

details.label: Top hypothesis
details.text: `[HIGH]` GPU 1 on `g22`, or its driver or KFD state, cannot allocate past about 194–198 GiB, although it reports about 84 GiB free. No change is blamed. Every failure is on TP1 (GPU 1), and they span three models, three images and two commits ([`e4c3f001`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/e4c3f001d6bc8cb43e778b6b27d562af550db8c9), [`fd4b4fdd`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/fd4b4fdd7385f172fd5c1b98d904cd8ceff77e0e)). **Disconfirming**: no hardware diagnostic from the node has been seen, and no failed job was re-run on another node.

details.label: In-flight fix
details.text: ❌ none found. This is node health, not an sglang PR.

details.label: Suggested triage
details.text: take `g22` out of service, check GPU 1 for retired pages, and re-run one of the five jobs on another node.

details.text: re-run only if one of these recurs. For the dumper test, bind port 0 and read back the chosen port.
